test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six people Sumit, Aamish, Saif, Ashutosh, Anubhav and Piyush are sitting in a straight row facing North. Only one person was sitting left to Piyush. Aamish is not sitting in either corner. Anubhav is sitting immediate left to Saif. Only one person is sitting in between Piyush and Ashutosh. Who is sitting to the immediate left of Ashutosh?
solution:
Given: Six people Sumit, Aamish, Saif, Ashutosh, Anubhav and Piyush.

1. Only one person was sitting left to Piyush. 

2. Only one person is sitting in between Piyush and Ashutosh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f8d162318e2420a008df2ad8205d75ab2a8a15c4fc93721815e61871ae4acd9.png] 

3. Anubhav is sitting immediate left to Saif.

4. Aamish is not sitting in either corner. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c36b86c59b21a81c2fe0a982998ab4c201035b5ba2597d8336fe33e41806914.png] 

And, Sumit sits in the remaining place that is on the left end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00b0d30eb435f7cfea5e5ef73d0e4a005322054cf9cfc573cb65604eaf6cc955.png] 

So, Aamish is sitting to the immediate left of Ashutosh.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Aamish"**.
